text:
Maya K: Quick morning note for release train 24 night ops. Canary observed anomalous p95 in eu-west3 starting ~00:30 UTC. Please read and react. :eyes:
Oliver: Got it. Short summary?
Maya K: Partner workload burst spiked requests ~+50%, p95 jumped to ~420ms for ~15m window, errors crept up. Affected only canary pool so far.
Release Bot: deploy-bot snapshot:
region: eu-west3 | window: 00:25-00:42 UTC | p50:120->130ms | p95:170->420ms | error:0.7%->1.9% | reqs:+48%
Jamie (SRE): Investigating. I applied a soft throttle on the partner route and increased canary capacity by +1 to reduce KV cache churn.
Charlie: Do we consider this a release hold?
Maya K: Recommendation: extend canary by +2h and hold promotes until 03:00 UTC or explicit all-clear. Not a hard rollback yet but treat as quiet window.
Tess: I'll watch metrics and post updates every 30m. If p95 >350ms for two consecutive 10m windows I'll open incidents/major.
Oliver: Any recent config flips that could explain the KV behavior? We toggled continuous_batching_v2 last deploy on that shard.
Jamie (SRE): I rolled back continuous_batching_v2 on the affected shard at 00:50 UTC as an experiment. Latency started trending down ~6m after. Keeping throttle for now.
Maya K: Action items:
- Tess: 30m cadence watch and escalate on threshold.
- Jamie: keep throttle, validate rollback impact on throughput and error-rate.
- Charlie: pause noncritical promotes and schema experiments for train 24 until hold lifted.
- Oliver: if this persists, file a short RC note; ops will decide on a postmortem.
Release Bot: policy-check: rollout-hold applied by @Maya K per Release Ops policy 4.2 (temporary hold for canary regressions).
Maya K: Emergency rollback command (if needed):
releasectl rollback --env=canary --to=v24-rc2 --reason="canary latency spike"

Jamie (SRE): status @00:58 UTC: p95 ~190ms, error-rate 1.1%, trending down. Will report +30m.
Oliver: I'll stand by for logs from model infra team.
Charlie: Updating release board and noting SLA impact.
Maya K: No formal freeze declared but treat train 24 as quiet. Thanks all, will post final readout when stable or if we take more action. :thumbsup:
